integrity: All 65536 vertex masks were exhaustively checked for each graph by two distinct standalone algorithms. Source code and observed outputs are embedded; no independent external audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact enumeration for two sixteen-vertex graphs only; no infinite-family formula, no external expert priority determination. The ordinary rook-graph maximum already follows from its known Zarankiewicz equivalence. The novelty claim concerns the paired complete coefficient census, Shrikhande optimum, and transitive isolated optimum families.
title: Visibility-polynomial separation and optimal-set symmetry of the Shrikhande–rook pair
